notes: s002 τε has no adjacent answering καί — the καί at s021 joins a later, different coordination — so rule 70 gives it the connective And rather than emptying it.
s006 τὴν is unrepresented because the determiner slot of the noun phrase is occupied by no, which belongs to οὐ; the following τυχοῦσαν is not a negative, so rules 41 and 59 do not arise.
s019 τόν is the second attributive article before ἐφεστῶτα with its head noun ὑετόν expressed, so rule 31 leaves it empty.
Both variant units are underdetermined but carry the base reading and the English realizes every projected token.
